capabilities.description: Synchronizes completed anime movies and episodes with AniList.

presentation.summary: Reliably synchronize completed anime with AniList through Silo's watch-provider pipeline.
presentation.description_markdown: Uses Silo's host-owned watch-sync pipeline for encrypted per-profile credentials, durable desired-state delivery, retries, and rich episode identity. Episode mappings come from the daily AniBridge v3 dataset. AniList progress is monotonic and ambiguous mappings are rejected rather than guessed.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin, configure an AniList OAuth application in Silo's watch-provider administration page, then connect AniList from the desired profile. Silo stores credentials encrypted and invokes this plugin as a stateless provider adapter.
